explanation: Article 23 names the five permanent members as they stood in 1945. Its list was never revised, though Russia took over the Soviet seat in December 1991.

claims.text: Article 23 of the UN Charter names the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics among the permanent members of the Security Council.
Article 23 lists the five permanent members by their 1945 names, and that list has never been changed, although the article was amended in 1965 to enlarge the council.
Russia took over the Soviet Union's permanent seat on the Security Council in December 1991.
